items.name: Chicken Biryani
items.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with tender spiced chicken, fried onions and fresh mint, served with cooling raita.

items.name: Classic Beef Burger
items.description: Juicy grilled patty, melted cheddar, crisp lettuce and house sauce in a toasted brioche bun with golden fries.

items.name: Margherita Pizza
items.description: Stone-baked crust with San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil leaves.

items.name: Creamy Alfredo Pasta
items.description: Penne folded through a silky parmesan cream sauce with garlic and a touch of black pepper.

items.name: Crispy Veg Samosa
items.description: Golden pastry parcels stuffed with spiced potato and peas, served with tangy tamarind chutney.

items.name: Loaded Fries
items.description: Thick-cut fries topped with cheese sauce, jalapeños and a sprinkle of smoky paprika.

items.name: Garden Fresh Salad
items.description: Crunchy greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives and feta with a lemon-olive oil dressing.

items.name: Grilled Chicken Bowl
items.description: Herb-grilled chicken over quinoa with roasted vegetables, avocado and a yoghurt drizzle.

items.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
items.description: A dense, glossy slice of dark chocolate cake with a rich ganache and a dusting of cocoa.

items.name: Fluffy Pancake Stack
items.description: Three buttermilk pancakes with maple syrup, fresh berries and a dollop of whipped cream.

items.name: Iced Latte
items.description: Smooth espresso poured over cold milk and ice, lightly sweetened for the long study session ahead.

items.name: Fresh Orange Juice
items.description: Cold-pressed oranges squeezed to order. Nothing added, nothing taken away.
